parts.t: Sunnyside Park Surrey is the MLS® sub-area in the middle of South Surrey. Sunnyside Park is also the name of a City park on 26 Avenue, so check which one a listing means. Its best-known open space is Sunnyside Acres, a 140-hectare forest that Surrey voters chose to protect in 1988. Next door, South Surrey Athletic Park holds most of the area’s playing fields. To the south, the Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan sets how the blocks around Semiahmoo will grow over the next 30 years. Most homes are on suburban streets, so the zone, the age of the house and the school path are the usual questions.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

The town centre plan applies to its own area, and the OCP and zoning cover the rest.
The Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan was approved on January 31, 2022. It runs from 16 Avenue (North Bluff Road) to 24 Avenue, and from about Martin Drive to Earl Marriott Secondary.
On July 27, 2026, Council approved updates to align the plan with King George Boulevard bus rapid transit and the Surrey 2050 OCP (Corporate Report CR171).
Rezoning applications in the plan area are still decided one project at a time, with a chance for residents to comment.

Why is it called Sunnyside Park Surrey?

That is the MLS® sub-area name. Sunnyside Park is also a City of Surrey park at 15455 26 Avenue, so check whether a listing means the sub-area or the park. The real estate board sets the sub-area lines.
What is Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest?
A 140-hectare park at 2598 144 Street with about 4 km of trails. It was one of the first dedicated urban forest parks in Canada after Surrey residents voted to protect it in 1988.
Is there a pool in Sunnyside Park?
has an outdoor pool, along with softball diamonds, tennis courts and two playgrounds.
What is at South Surrey Athletic Park?
, at 14600 20 Avenue, has fields and courts for soccer, football, rugby, baseball, tennis, pickleball and volleyball, plus a bike park, a playground and a water playground.

Is there a cemetery in Sunnyside?
Yes. Sunnyside Lawn Cemetery, a City cemetery at 14850 28 Avenue, has offered burials since 1954. Part of the historic Semiahmoo Trail runs through it.
